author: reek
body: The work is present, it hashes to the digest it was quoted by, it is signed, and the signature verifies. Everything the bytes can prove about themselves, they prove.

author: reek
body: The key that signed it scores one thousand, and this chapter said it would take nothing below five. A signature says who stands behind a definition; it does not say we have to take their word for it. That is the fourth guard, and it is the only one that is a judgement rather than a fact.
